Autor e executor obrigatórios; parentId: Author and executor are required; parentId is optional. A child may be on another board with another executor. No fixed depth limit; reject self-reference and cycles. For a root, rootTaskId is the generated id and originBoardId is boardId; a child retains its parent's rootTaskId/originBoardId. The existing PATCH does not edit parentId or boardId; this revision adds no reparenting API.
Autor/dono obrigatório e imutável; agent: Required, immutable author/owner: the agent that wrote the task. Independent of the declared actor submitting the request.
Autoria declarada; sem autenticação ou p: Declared authorship; no authentication or proof of identity.
Before deve ser irmão na mesma coluna. N: Before must be a sibling in the same column. Null moves to the end. statusId must remain the current status, including a final status; any change returns 409 summary_required even with currentSummary. Change status by recording execution-summaries or close_activity with a complete execution. Reordering within the same status preserves the current summary when omitted.
Board de origem da task principal govern: The root task's origin board governs the entire recursive chain, including cross-board descendants. originBoardMode=manual forces effectiveMode=manual; automatic forces automatic; standard uses only the current task's autonomyMode. Do not inherit the parent flag or consult the destination board mode. Do not modify persisted settings. rootTaskId/originBoardId are derived from the chain and carried by the harness; the server does not execute tasks.
Campos textuais omitidos viram string va: Omitted text fields become empty strings, omitted arrays become []; image defaults to null.
Chave de requisição, não ID de entidade: Request key, not a persisted entity ID; any UUID version.
Completed exige status final e sem bloqu: Completed requires a final status and no block, and sets progress to 100. Other outcomes require a nonfinal status; blocked requires an existing block. Review follows the user's instructions, with no universally required review stage. The supplied context must match the task chain, including cross-board origin; a mismatch returns 409 execution_context_mismatch. currentSummary is the required current cumulative synthesis, saved atomically on the task; summary remains the historical record of this activity.
Composição final de time alterado (inclu: Final composition of a changed team (including an archived source), with a required leader. Unspecified teams remain unchanged; validate versions and final role cardinality.
Composição somente por comando atômico s: Composition changes only through the separate atomic command.
Conflito estrutural, versão em composiçã: Structural conflict, composition version conflict, archived/in-use resource, idempotency conflict or incompatible execution context; not authentication.
Criador declarado na requisição. human i: Creator declared in the request. human identifies the local user; agent uses a persisted ID. Identity is not verified.
Criar board com teamId gestor obrigatóri: Create a board with a required managing teamId and preserved declared creator. A team may manage multiple boards. Tasks do not inherit team membership. Initial autonomyMode is manual.
Criar grupo com líder e membros, sem ent: Create a group with a leader and members, without a higher-level grouping entity or task ownership. Identities must exist and role cardinalities must be valid.

ETag forte da entidade alvo; em comandos: Strong ETag of the target entity; for content commands, the task; for status ordering, the board.
Edita conteúdo/progresso, currentSummary: Edit content/progress, currentSummary and individual mode without changing authorAgentId/boardId/parentId. Progress requires a nonempty currentSummary in the same call; administrative changes preserve it when omitted. Reassignment uses Assignment. manual/automatic modes do not propagate to children; effective mode uses the chain's origin board.
Editar metadados, modo e/ou teamId gesto: Edit metadata, mode and/or managing teamId. Uses the board If-Match. A valid transfer records board.management_changed and the new teamId atomically; it does not change creator, task authors/executors, parentId, originBoardId or history. Supplying the current teamId creates no transfer event.
Estado final completo dos times afetados: Complete final state of affected teams in one transaction. May remove/transfer an agent from an archived team; preserves identity, tasks and authorship. Archiving does not release bindings. Allow at most one binding per role, in different teams; do not impose task or board constraints.
Exclusão lógica: corresponde a deleted_a: Soft deletion: corresponds to deleted_at in PostgreSQL; does not physically remove data.
Executor obrigatório, reatribuível pelo: Required executor, reassignable by the user without a team restriction.
